projects.name: 20022 Migration
details: Supported the migration of payment messaging from SWIFT MT to ISO20022 MX formats, aligning with SWIFT CBPR+
and regulatory mandates. Conducted requirement analysis, message mapping, and UAT coordination to enable seamless and
accurate payment processing.
Responsibilities:
• Supported end-to-end ISO2022 migration initiative for cross-border and domestic payments, ensuring compliance with
SWIFT and regulatory standards.
• Gathered and documented business and functional requirements for payment message transformation using BRD, FRD,
User Stories and Process Flows.
• Performed message mapping and gap analysis between MT (MT103, MT202, MT195 etc.) and MX standards (pacs.008,
pacs.009, camt.053 etc.) to ensure accurate data translation.
• Conducted As-Is and To-Be analysis for payments transformation workflows
• Defined business rules and functional requirements for MT-MX message conversion aligned with SWIFT CBPR+ standards
• Facilitated requirement workshops with business, compliance, operations and IT stakeholders
• Collaborated with QA and development teams to validate payment workflows and resolve defects during SIT/UAT phases
• Experienced in Agile Scrum, breaking down requirements into epics, features, and user stories
• Analyzed payment exceptions and reconciliation gaps to ensure seamless payment processing
• Created document for the new processes and systems, including user manuals and technical guides

projects.name: Onboarding & Screening Management
details: The project was about implementing a client life cycle management system to streamline client onboarding with KYC,
AML, Sanctions & Due Diligence checks, ensuring compliance with global regulations and improving efficiency, data
quality & client experience.
Responsibilities:
• Gathered and documented requirements for Client Onboarding, KYC, AML, and sanctions screening processes ensuring
alignment with project scope, objectives and deliverable.
• Worked with compliance and operations teams to automate client onboarding workflows, reducing onboarding
time by 40%
• Designed and validated screening rules for PEP and sanction list checks
• Identified key stakeholders, analyzed their power on the project, and strategically engaged them throughout the project
• Collaborated with compliance, operations, and technology teams to streamline onboarding workflows and improve
operational efficiency
• Prepared user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation for onboarding and screening modules
• Participated in scrum meetings (stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives) with Development Team,

projects.name: (Swift Message Search Application)
details: Worked on the development of a SWIFT Message Search Application enabling users to quickly access, validate, and track
SWIFT MT/MX messages; improving reconciliation and compliance with SWIFT standards.
Responsibilities:
• Gathered & documented business requirements for searching and retrieving SWIFT MT & ISO20022 messages to support payments investigation and compliance team
• Designed functional and non-functional requirements including search filters (by date, sender/receiver, transaction
ref., amount, payment status)
• Elicited & translated business requirements into User Stories and assigned them to Sprints in Agile Methodology
• Worked with development team to validate messages
• Conducted Impact Analysis on Business Process using techniques like Use Case Diagram
• Designed Requirement Traceability Matrix(RTM) to manage requirements
• Involved in creating wireframes and mockups for the system using MS VISIO
• Responsible for coordinating and scheduling meetings, workshops, and other project-related gatherings
• Provided ongoing support to users and stakeholders to address any issues, challenges related to SWIFT Messages
• Used JIRA for bug tracking and reporting, also followed up with the development team to verify bug fixes
